info.desc: Let England Shake is the eighth studio album by PJ Harvey. It was released on 14 February 2011 in the UK, and on 15 February 2011 in the US. Work on it began around the time of White Chalk's release in 2007, though it is a departure from the piano-driven introspective collection of that album. It was written between late 2007 and 2008, and recorded over a five-week period. .

podcast.body: PJ Harvey's 2011 album is described as experimental folk rock with a liberal dose of alternative influences. It won the Mercury Music Prize that year, making her the only artist to win the prestigious English music award twice. The album was also awarded the Ivor Novello Songwriting Award in 2012.
